facts.fact: PMAY-G unit assistance for a pucca house is Rs 1.20 lakh in plain areas
facts.quote: Unit assistance is fixed at ₹1.20 lakh in plain areas and ₹1.30 lakh in hilly states, difficult areas, and Integrated Action Plan (IAP) districts.

facts.fact: PMAY-G unit assistance is Rs 1.30 lakh in hilly states, difficult areas and IAP districts
facts.quote: Unit assistance is fixed at ₹1.20 lakh in plain areas and ₹1.30 lakh in hilly states, difficult areas, and Integrated Action Plan (IAP) districts.

facts.fact: The beneficiary is also entitled to 90-95 person-days of unskilled labour under MGNREGS
facts.quote: Beneficiaries are entitled to 90–95 person-days of unskilled labour under MGNREGS.

facts.fact: Toilet support comes through convergence with SBM-G or MGNREGS
facts.quote: Assistance for toilet construction is leveraged through convergence with Swachh Bharat Mission-Gramin (SBM-G), MGNREGS, or dedicated funding sources.

facts.fact: The SBM-G incentive for an individual household toilet (IHHL) is Rs 12,000
facts.quote: Incentive of Rs.12,000/- for construction of IHHL will be continued for all new eligible households

facts.fact: The minimum house size is 25 sq m including a hygienic cooking space
facts.quote: The minimum size of the house has been increased to 25 sq. mt. (from 20 sq. mt.) including a hygienic cooking space.

facts.fact: The cost is shared Centre:State 60:40 in plain areas and 90:10 for North-Eastern and Himalayan States
facts.quote: The cost of unit assistance is shared between the Central and State Governments in a 60:40 ratio for plain areas, and 90:10 for North Eastern and Himalayan States.

facts.fact: Beneficiaries are selected from SECC 2011 and Awaas+ based Permanent Wait Lists verified by the Gram Sabha
facts.quote: Under this scheme, the beneficiaries are identified through SECC 2011 and Awaas+ (2018) surveys, verified by Gram Sabhas.

summary: All PMAY-G figures still stand on pmayg.dord.gov.in About page (Rs 1.20/1.30 lakh, 90-95 days MGNREGS, 25 sq m, 60:40/90:10, SECC/Awaas+ PWL) and SBM-G FAQ (IHHL Rs 12,000).
